finalText:
**The build passes now.** Exit 0, no errors.

Two real bugs hid in the warnings. Both came from the bump.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The bundler now sends `retryCount`. It reads both names now.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. The new loader leaves it `undefined`. Unset now means off, as before.

The 8 leftover warnings are noise. They name files this project does not have.
